---
name: Content report or counter-notice
about: Report a Community item or profile that breaks the rules, appeal a decision, or send a counter-notice
title: "Content report: <item title or public name>"
labels: moderation
assignees: ''
---

<!--
Issues on GitHub are PUBLIC. Do not post private details, personal data of other people, or copies of harmful files.
For copyright, use the "Copyright notice" template. For a malware report, describe what you saw; do not attach the file.
Rules: docs/COMMUNITY_GUIDELINES.md. Process: docs/ENFORCEMENT.md.
-->

**What is this about?** (keep one)
- [ ] Report: adult content that is not flagged 18+
- [ ] Report: malware or hidden / unsafe code
- [ ] Report: hate or harassment
- [ ] Report: spam or scam
- [ ] Report: impersonation
- [ ] Report: personal data of someone
- [ ] Report: other rule violation
- [ ] Appeal: I disagree with a moderation decision about my content or account
- [ ] Counter-notice: my content was hidden or removed after a copyright claim (see docs/COPYRIGHT.md)

**Item or profile**
- Title / public name:
- Item id or link (if the app shows one):

**What is wrong, or why the decision should change** (be specific and factual):

**For a counter-notice only**
- Why you have the right to share it (you created it, licence and source with links, permission):
- Statement: I have a good-faith belief this content was hidden or removed by mistake or misidentification, or that I have the right to share it. (under penalty of perjury where that applies)
- Signature (typed full name):

**Contact**: a public handle, or write "available privately".
